string.name: desc
string.value:
Masters everything you have learned as a Paladin to increase Weapon Mastery, DEF, and Minimum Critical Damage. Increases Damage or DEF Ignored depend on the equipped weapon's type.
Blunt Weapons: Ignores a certain % of enemy DEF
Sword Weapons: Increases Damage
Required Skill: #cWeapon Mastery Lv. 10 or above#

string.value: Mastery: +#mastery%, DEF: +#pddX, Minimum Critical Damage: +#criticaldamageMin%\nMaximum Critical Damage +10% when equipped with a Sword\nIgnores 5% of enemy DEF when equipped with a Blunt weapon
